dcterms:description: Polish language dependency treebank with sentiment annotations, intended to study compositional phenomena in sentiment analysis. It contains sentences from various sources, including product reviews.
dcterms:title: Polish Sentiment Treebank (TW)

dcterms:description: A dataset containing one thousand Polish language tweets, manually labeled for sentiment during the TrendMiner project. It includes tweets from various public figures and a representative sample of general communication on Twitter.
dcterms:title: Twitter Data

dcterms:description: A dataset consisting of one thousand manually collected movie reviews from a Polish website. Reviews vary in length and are associated with a numeric score from 1 to 10, which has been re-scaled into three sentiment categories.
dcterms:title: Movie Reviews
